HOW IT WORKS

How a pick gets posted.

No hunches and no favorite players. A pick posts only when the numbers say the price is good.

01
⌕

We price every prop

Lines from the major sportsbooks for every posted NFL player prop, rechecked about every 15 minutes on game days.

02
✓

Only real edges qualify

A pick posts when the best price beats the sportsbooks’ consensus by at least 1%, with three or more books pricing both sides.

03
🔒

Locked, then graded

Each pick is timestamped before kickoff and graded from box scores. Nothing gets deleted, and the losses stay up too.
